NOTICE-2 (FINALY
| in line with RBI guidelines, Bank is in the process of carrying
out periodic updation of KYC of existing customers and also in
process of reviving relationship with the customers who are
maintaining Saving Bank and/or Current Deposit account but
not operating their accounts since long time.
In the above process, Bank has observed that many accounts,
having zero balance are turned inoperative (Dormant) on or
before 30.09.2022. In order to prevent misuse of such
Dormant accounts, Bank has decided to close all such
accounts which were not operated since last 5 years and are in
Dormant status since last 3 years.
We bring to the notice of all such customers that Bank is keen
to continue its relationship with customers who would like to
revive their Zero Balance Dormant accounts to active status
and hence hereby advise all such customers to contact the
concerned/ nearest branch for updating their KYC and
resumption of operations immediately within 30 days from the
date of this notice.
The following accounts shall be exempted from the above
closure process:
PMJDY (BSBDA/BSBDS) Scheme, A/c's frozen by Court
Order /1.T. Dept or any other statutory authority, DEA Fund
Accounts, Account linked to locker, Accounts with lien for any
amount.
Please note that Bank may proceed with closure of all such
Zero Balance accounts which are not activated by submitting
the KYC documents within 30 days from the date of this notice.
Date : 15.12.2025
